class.name: SteamHttpOptions
class.brief_description: Branchable HTTP options and actions for one Steam client scope.
class.description: Each modifier returns a new branch. The same HTTP terminal can be called on [SteamHttp] with defaults or on a configured branch.

method.name: accept_json
method.description: Return a branch with the request's Accept header set to [code]application/json[/code].

method.name: with_header
method.description: Return a branch with a request header. Header names are case-insensitive, and a new value replaces the same header on that branch. Steam manages framing and connection headers.

method.name: with_timeout
method.description: Return a branch with an absolute deadline from 100 to 120,000 milliseconds. The default is 15,000 milliseconds.

method.name: with_max_response_bytes
method.description: Return a branch with a response body limit from 1 byte to 4 MiB. The default is 1 MiB. Larger bodies return a limit error and expose no partial response.

method.name: with_response_headers
method.description: Return a branch that replaces the selected response header names. Select up to 16 additional names. Matching ignores case, and Content-Type is captured when present. A selected field larger than 2,048 bytes returns a limit error.

method.name: fetch
method.description: Send an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL using GET. Returns a [SteamHttpResponseResult] after [code]await[/code].

method.name: head
method.description: Send HEAD and return status and captured headers with an empty body. Returns a [SteamHttpResponseResult] after [code]await[/code].

method.name: post
method.description: Send the supplied dictionary as a JSON POST body. Returns a [SteamHttpResponseResult] after [code]await[/code].

method.name: put
method.description: Send the supplied dictionary as a JSON PUT body. Returns a [SteamHttpResponseResult] after [code]await[/code].

method.name: patch
method.description: Send the supplied dictionary as a JSON PATCH body. Returns a [SteamHttpResponseResult] after [code]await[/code].

method.name: delete
method.description: Send DELETE using the selected options. Returns a [SteamHttpResponseResult] after [code]await[/code].

method.name: options
method.description: Send OPTIONS using the selected options. Returns a [SteamHttpResponseResult] after [code]await[/code].

method.name: request
method.description: Create an unsent request draft with the selected options. The default method is GET.
